title: Decontamination corridor layout
description: Layout of a decontamination corridor as a list of stations in order, with the zone, the purpose, the crew and the supplies at each, and where patients are handed to medical care. No technique detail.

agency.description: Agency or unit that keeps this record.

incidentName.description: Incident name as command announced it.
examples: Tank car leak at Harlan Spur

marking.description: Exercise marking printed at the top and bottom. Defaults to the standard exercise marking.

location.description: Where it is set up and its relation to the wind.
examples: Uphill and upwind of the spur, east side of Harlan Road

stations.description: Stations from the hot zone side to the cold zone side.

notes.description: Where decontaminated patients are handed to medical care and what is done with runoff.
examples: Patients move to the Medical Group after step 4 with their tag. Runoff is directed to the containment berm.
